candidates.name: PetersenLib.secondFundamentalForm
candidates.scope: Pi(X,Y) = g(nabla_X N,Y), using the ambient affine connection. Symmetry is proved for smooth tangent fields with tangent Lie bracket; a level-set lemma supplies bracket tangency.
candidates.needed_bridge: Adapt RiemannianMetric and RiemannianConnection to the current metric/connection interfaces and relate local normal-field expressions to an actual smooth immersion.

candidates.name: PetersenLib.tangentialCurvatureEquation
candidates.scope: A proved Gauss curvature identity for the explicitly constructed tangential covariant derivative and its curvature, under smoothness and orthogonality hypotheses. The algebraic theorem does not assume the Gauss identity itself.
candidates.needed_bridge: Identify tangential curvature with intrinsic curvature of OpenGA.Surface.inducedMetric. The comment cites uniqueness of the Riemannian connection, but this identification is not a theorem in the reviewed GaussCodazzi file.
